concept: Sapphire Studios runs on electric ink: a deep sapphire-blue primary cut against crisp off-white paper, with a hot magenta accent for needle-sharp highlights. Near-black ink and dark-leaning charcoal surfaces evoke fresh-line tattoo work, while the cool electric-blue secondary keeps the palette bold, clean, and artistic.
contrastNotes: All required ratios verified via WCAG relative-luminance. ink #0C1018 on bg #F4F5F8 = 17.47:1 (>=7); ink-soft #515A6B on bg = 6.37:1 (>=4.5); white on primary #1C3FAE = 8.85:1 (>=4.5); primary on bg = 8.12:1 (>=3). Extras: white on primary-dark = 12.6:1; white on secondary #2563EB = 5.17:1; white on accent #D6217F = 4.79:1 (text-safe); ink on white surface = 19.0:1. Charcoal surface-alt #14161D is for dark inverted sections and pairs with bg/ink for white text (>15:1).
